# Slurm Scheduler (Anvil)

All real computation on Anvil runs as **Slurm** jobs. Never run compute on a login
node (see `unix.md`) — submit it here.

## Every Anvil job needs three things

A job request must specify **resources**, an **account**, and a **partition**. On
Anvil you MUST explicitly set **both the account (`-A`/`--account=`) and the
partition (`-p`/`--partition=`)**, and always a time limit (`--time`).

- Discover the accounts you can charge (and their balances) with **`mybalance`** — do not
  guess an account name.
- Set a realistic `--time`; memory is allocated in proportion to the cores you request.

## Partitions

| Partition | For | Notes |
|-----------|-----|-------|
| `debug` | Testing and debugging (CPU) | up to 2 nodes / 256 cores; max 2 h; 1 running, 2 queued per user |
| `gpu-debug` | Testing and debugging (GPU) | 1 node, up to 2 GPUs; max 30 min; 1 running, 2 queued per user |
| `wholenode` | Multi-node CPU jobs (128-core nodes) | node-exclusive (charged 128 cores per node); up to 16 nodes; max 96 h |
| `wide` | Large multi-node CPU jobs | node-exclusive; up to 56 nodes / 7,168 cores; max 12 h; 5 running per user |
| `shared` | Single-node CPU jobs that share a node; the default partition | 1 node, up to 128 cores; max 96 h |
| `highmem` | Large-memory jobs (1 TB nodes) | 1 node; max 48 h; charged 4 SU per core |
| `gpu` | GPU jobs (4× NVIDIA A100 40 GB per node) | needs GPU credits; max 48 h; max 12 GPUs in use per user |
| `ai` | AI jobs (4× NVIDIA H100 80 GB per node) | needs AI credits; max 48 h; max 12 GPUs in use per user |

## Common commands

`sbatch` (submit a batch script), `squeue -u $USER` (your jobs), `scontrol show job
<id>` (job detail), `scontrol hold`/`release`, `scancel <id>` (cancel), `sinteractive`
(interactive job), `srun` (launch tasks).

## Prohibitions

- **Do NOT** request a `standby`, `partner`, or owner queue or QOS. None exist on Anvil, and all partitions have equal priority.
- **Do NOT** omit `-A` or `-p`. Without them the job goes to `shared` and may be charged to an unintended account.
- **Do NOT** send small or single-core jobs to `wholenode` or `wide`. Those partitions are node-exclusive and charge all 128 cores per node; use `shared`.
- **Do NOT** use `highmem` unless the job needs more memory than a standard node. It is charged 4 SU per core.
- **Do NOT** charge `gpu` or `ai` jobs to a CPU-only account. CPU, GPU and AI credits are separate; check `mybalance` for an account with credits for that partition.
- **Do NOT** request `--mem-per-cpu=2G`. The default is about 1896 MB per core, and asking for more can allocate extra cores and raise the charge.
- **Do NOT** emit flags for other schedulers (PBS/Torque `#PBS`, LSF `#BSUB`) — this is
  Slurm.
- **Do NOT** invent partition names; the valid partitions are listed above.
- **Do NOT** submit jobs without a `--time` limit, and **do NOT** `scancel` jobs you do
  not own or run bulk cancellations without confirming with the user.

## Anvil specifics

- Jobs are charged in service units (SUs) against the allocation account: on CPU nodes 1 SU is one core-hour, and on GPU nodes 1 SU is one GPU-hour. Find partition limits with `showpartitions`.
